name: nmr-companion
description: Editable local NMR workbench for organic evidence and signed relaxation analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Shared NMR projects for people and agents.
interface.longDescription: Prerelease: shared GUI/MCP projects, qualified 1D and processed COSY/HSQC imports, structures and evidence, yield/recovery, explicit conditions, T1/T2 fits and revision-bound exports. Instrument, model and host qualification is recorded separately.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me analyse NMR data with explicit units, provenance and editable results.
